candidates.change_summary: Change the function to return false immediately after successful calls instead of true at the end (replace final return true with return false).
Invert the loop so that if any call succeeds the function returns true immediately; otherwise require at least one success (changes return timing and value).
Instead of requiring each call success, aggregate success flags and return whether all calls succeeded (remove require and return combined result).
Change call to staticcall so the external transferFrom invocation becomes a static (non-state-mutating) call, which can alter observable state changes caused by the callee.
Remove the require that checks the callee call success, allowing failed external transferFrom calls to be ignored and thus changing observed outcomes.
Change the loop to iterate from length-1 down to 0 (reverse order), which can alter the sequence of external calls and thus observable state.
Change the selector computed to a different function signature (transfer(address,address,uint256)) so a different external function is invoked, altering observable effects.
